requirements.name: font-family
requirements.note: Ordered named/generic families resolved against explicit FontCatalog bindings; no system lookup or per-character fallback. Complete CSS1 matching remains unqualified.

requirements.name: font-style
requirements.note: Normal and italic only; no oblique matching.

requirements.name: font-variant
requirements.note: Small capitals are not implemented.

requirements.name: font-weight
requirements.note: Four supplied style variants; no relative weight matching or full 100–900 family repertoire.

requirements.name: font-size
requirements.note: Absolute keywords index a fixed table for a 12pt (16 CSS px) medium and larger/smaller scale the parent's computed size by 1.2, as both browser witnesses compute; the CSS1 example making larger from medium equal large is a recorded deviation. Positive supported lengths and percentages. Zero sizes and the ex unit remain unsupported; full context qualification is pending.

requirements.name: font
requirements.note: Atomic supported font shorthand with a size or size keyword, optional line height and family list; omitted components reset. Small caps, oblique and relative weight keywords remain unsupported.

requirements.name: color
requirements.note: CSS1 hex, named colors and homogeneous signed integer/percentage rgb() with channel clipping; selected later color keywords remain explicit extensions. Full context/error qualification is pending.

requirements.name: background-color
requirements.note: Solid/transparent box backgrounds and selected root/body canvas propagation; full contexts remain unqualified.

requirements.name: background-image
requirements.note: Background images are not implemented.

requirements.name: background-repeat
requirements.note: Background tiling is not implemented.

requirements.name: background-attachment
requirements.note: Background attachment is not implemented.

requirements.name: background-position
requirements.note: Background positioning is not implemented.

requirements.name: background
requirements.note: Color-only alias; reset of all shorthand components is not implemented.

requirements.name: word-spacing
requirements.note: Inherited normal or signed absolute/font-relative lengths; applies to U+0020 and U+00A0 after whitespace processing. Layout, painting and link bounds share the adjusted shaped advances. Percentage values and a negative total run advance remain unsupported; full context qualification is pending. Preserved tabs with nonzero spacing are explicitly rejected; normal-spacing tabs retain the existing unqualified tab-stop profile.

requirements.name: letter-spacing
requirements.note: Inherited normal or signed absolute/font-relative lengths. Nonzero spacing follows grapheme boundaries, including a trailing advance, without separating a base from combining marks; optional ligatures are disabled. Normal and zero preserve the original shaping. This convention has selected browser/PDF witnesses, not full CSS Text qualification. Nonzero spacing across graphemes split between inline runs and negative total run advances are rejected. Preserved tabs with nonzero spacing are explicitly rejected; normal-spacing tabs retain the existing unqualified tab-stop profile.

requirements.name: text-decoration
requirements.note: Underline/none only; no overline or line-through.

requirements.name: vertical-align
requirements.note: Table-cell extension only; CSS1 inline alignment is absent.

requirements.name: text-transform
requirements.note: Case transformation is not implemented.

requirements.name: text-align
requirements.note: Left, center and right; justification absent.

requirements.name: text-indent
requirements.note: Inherited signed absolute/font-relative lengths or deferred percentages of the line-containing block content width. Only its first eligible formatted line is indented, without restarting after a BR, pagination or an intervening in-flow block. Selected float, alignment and fragmentation contexts are tested; full CSS1 qualification is pending. An indent leaving no positive line width is explicitly rejected.

requirements.name: line-height
requirements.note: Numbers, supported lengths and percentages; full inline line-box rules remain unqualified.

requirements.name: margin-top
requirements.note: Positive lengths and positive collapse; negative, percentage and auto margins absent.

requirements.name: margin-right
requirements.note: Positive lengths and positive collapse; negative, percentage and auto margins absent.

requirements.name: margin-bottom
requirements.note: Positive lengths and positive collapse; negative, percentage and auto margins absent.

requirements.name: margin-left
requirements.note: Positive lengths and positive collapse; negative, percentage and auto margins absent.

requirements.name: margin
requirements.note: Positive lengths and positive collapse; negative, percentage and auto margins absent.

requirements.name: padding-top
requirements.note: Positive lengths; percentage padding absent.

requirements.name: padding-right
requirements.note: Positive lengths; percentage padding absent.

requirements.name: padding-bottom
requirements.note: Positive lengths; percentage padding absent.

requirements.name: padding-left
requirements.note: Positive lengths; percentage padding absent.

requirements.name: padding
requirements.note: Positive lengths; percentage padding absent.

requirements.name: border-top-width
requirements.note: Independent sides, CSS1 styles, width keywords and atomic shorthands. Computed styles preserve zero-width styles and transparent colors; inline borders remain unsupported and complete per-value/context qualification is pending.

requirements.name: border-right-width

requirements.name: border-width
requirements.note: Independent sides, CSS1 styles, width keywords and atomic shorthands. Computed styles preserve zero-width styles and transparent colors; inline borders remain unsupported and complete per-value/context qualification is pending.

requirements.name: border-color
requirements.note: Independent sides, CSS1 styles, width keywords and atomic shorthands. Computed styles preserve zero-width styles and transparent colors; inline borders remain unsupported and complete per-value/context qualification is pending.

requirements.note: Independent sides, CSS1 styles, width keywords and atomic shorthands. Computed styles preserve zero-width styles and transparent colors; inline borders remain unsupported and complete per-value/context qualification is pending.

requirements.note: Independent sides, CSS1 styles, width keywords and atomic shorthands. Computed styles preserve zero-width styles and transparent colors; inline borders remain unsupported and complete per-value/context qualification is pending.

requirements.name: border-left
requirements.note: Independent sides, CSS1 styles, width keywords and atomic shorthands. Computed styles preserve zero-width styles and transparent colors; inline borders remain unsupported and complete per-value/context qualification is pending.

requirements.name: border
requirements.note: Independent sides, CSS1 styles, width keywords and atomic shorthands. Computed styles preserve zero-width styles and transparent colors; inline borders remain unsupported and complete per-value/context qualification is pending.

requirements.name: width
requirements.note: Content widths and percentages; full intrinsic/replaced sizing remains unqualified.

requirements.name: height
requirements.note: Explicit non-percentage heights; visible overflow is retained in bounded float contexts, while ordinary-flow overflow remains rejected.

requirements.name: float
requirements.note: Explicit-width left/right placement, nested contexts and line exclusions within a one-page document. No intrinsic sizing, table combinations or float fragmentation. Decorated normal blocks overlapping earlier floats and floats introduced after inline text on the same line are rejected.

requirements.name: clear
requirements.note: Left/right/both clearance in bounded one-page float contexts; complete margin-collapse and fragmentation interactions remain unqualified.

requirements.name: display
requirements.note: Native block/inline/list elements, float blockification and list-marker suppression with display:block; arbitrary display remapping remains unqualified.

requirements.name: white-space
requirements.note: Whitespace modes exist; complete CSS1 line-breaking behavior remains unqualified.

requirements.name: list-style-type
requirements.note: Disc/circle/square/decimal/none; Roman and alphabetic numbering absent.

requirements.name: list-style-image
requirements.note: Image list markers are absent.

requirements.name: list-style-position
requirements.note: Only the native outside marker model exists.

requirements.name: list-style
requirements.note: List shorthand is absent.

requirements.name: selectors
requirements.note: Basic and escaped selectors, atomic selector lists and bounded matching; CSS1 anchor pseudo-classes and typographical pseudo-elements remain absent.

requirements.name: cascade
requirements.note: Author cascade, atomic declaration validation and explicit ordered imports; user-origin styles and complete historical-versus-modern precedence qualification remain absent.

requirements.name: inheritance
requirements.note: Supported inherited fields are tested; absent properties prevent full inheritance coverage.

requirements.name: formatting
requirements.note: Positive margins, specified line heights, explicit-width floats and clearance have bounded witnesses. Negative margins, parent-child collapse with floats, intrinsic float widths and fragmentation remain unqualified.

requirements.name: font-matching
requirements.note: Complete CSS1 font matching, per-character fallback and weight repertoire are absent; explicit ordered family/generic bindings are covered as a partial font-family property.

requirements.name: units
requirements.note: Absolute lengths, em and selected percentages; ex and full percentage contexts are absent.

requirements.name: syntax-recovery
requirements.note: Strict rejection by default; Report diagnoses invalid syntax and preserves supported adjacent declarations/rules using original lexical values. Complete forward-compatible browser recovery remains unqualified.

requirements.name: imports
requirements.note: Ordered recursive @import from the explicit catalog, relative references and print/all selection; cycles, depth and cumulative work are bounded. No implicit retrieval; full syntax/media qualification is pending.

requirements.name: canvas
requirements.note: Solid root backgrounds and transparent-root body propagation are covered by selected parser/native raster witnesses; the full canvas/background requirement is not qualified.
